snippet.title: Mind the Clown: Reborn - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Mind the Clown: Reborn is a first-person survival horror game set in a cursed circus twisted by childhood memories. Escape a demonic clown and explore danger-filled attractions. Hide, flee and burn the posters to break the curse before it claims your life.

Wishlist now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5165650/Mind_the_Clown_Reborn/
